rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for someone or something in the teenage age range, used approximately.

example.english: Teenage students start to have ideas of their own.
example.traditional: 十幾歲學生開始有自己嘅諗法。
example.jyutping: sap6 gei2 seoi3 hok6 saang1 hoi1 ci2 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 nam2 faat3

rows.jyutping: sap6 saam1 zi3 sap6 gau2 seoi3
rows.note: Use this when the age range must be stated exactly rather than approximated as 十幾歲.

example.english: Teenage youths aged thirteen to nineteen are usually playful.
example.traditional: 十三至十九歲嘅青少年通常都好貪玩。
example.jyutping: sap6 saam1 zi3 sap6 gau2 seoi3 ge3 cing1 siu3 nin4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hou2 taam1 waan2
